sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Third Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 2nd May, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/8512, dated
2-5-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment)
Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West
Frontier Province on the 20th April, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of
the North-West Frontier Province on the 28th April, 1992, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Local Government (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
Once.

2. Amendment of section 28 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance, IV of
1979.----In the North-West
Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance IV of
1979), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 28--
(i) in clause (f), the word "and'
occurring at the end shall be deleted;
(ii) in clause (h), the full-stop appearing
at the end shall be replaced by a semi-colon and thereafter the word
"and" shall be inserted; and
(iii) after clause (h), as so amended, the
following new clause shall be added, namely:
"(i) if he has been removed from the
office of a Local Council under clause (c) of section 34, or debarred from
holding office of any Local Council under section 158 (5), unless a period of
five years has elapsed from the date of orders passed under the respective
provisions."

3. Amendment of section 31 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance, IV of 1979.--In the said Ordinance, in section 31 in
subsection (1):--
(i) in the first proviso for the words `six
months' the words `one year' should be substituted;
(ii) the full-stop appearing at the end of
the second proviso shall be replaced by a colon and thereafter the following
new proviso shall be added, namely.
"Provided also that where the Local Councils have been dissolved
under the second proviso, Government shall:--
(a) hold elections to reconstitute the Local
Councils within a period not exceeding eighteen months from the date of
dissolution of the Local Councils, and
(b) appoint
persons, during the period the Local Councils remain dissolved, to perform such
functions of the Local Councils as may be specified."

4. Amendment of section 34 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance, IV of
1979: -In the said Ordinance, in section 34, for subsection (2) the
following shall be substituted, namely:
"(2) A
Chairman or Vice-Chairman or Member removed under subsection (1) may, within 30
days of the order of removal, file an appeal to the Tribunal comprised of the
Senior Member, Board of Revenue, North-West Frontier Province. The Tribunal
shall, for the purpose of hearing an appeal, have the powers of a Court under
the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (V of 1908)."

6. Amendment of section 132 of
N.W.F.P. Ordinance, IV of
1979.--In the said
Ordinance, in section 132, for subsection (1), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"132. Surcharge.--(1) Every
member of a Local Council, every official or servant of a Local Council arid
every person charged with the administration of the affairs of a Local Council
shall be liable for the loss, waste, misappropriation or misapplication of any
money or property belonging to a Local Council which is a direct consequence of
his negligence or misconduct, and shall be liable to pay such surcharge as may
be determined by a Committee to be constituted by Government and such amount
shall be recoverable as a public demand or as arrears of land revenue."

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Local Government Third Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 158 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance, IV of 1979

ACT V OF 1992
ACT V OF 1992
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to
amend the North-West Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 2nd May, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/8512, dated
2-5-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Amendment)
Bill, 1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West
Frontier Province on the 20th April, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of
the North-West Frontier Province on the 28th April, 1992, is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
7. Amendment of section 158 of N.W.F.P. Ordinance, IV of
1979: -In the said
Ordinance, in section 158,--
(i) for subsection (1), the following shall
be substituted namely:
"(1) Government may, whether suo motu
or on the application made to it by any person, cause an inquiry to be made by
such person as may be authorised by it in this behalf, into the affairs of a
Local Council generally or into any particular matter concerning a Local
Council, at any time and take such remedial measures as may be warranted by the
findings of such inquiry."
(ii) after subsection (4), the following new
subsection (5) shall be added, namely:
"(5) Government
may, after giving him an opportunity of being heard, by an order in writing,
debar a person, who is or was a Chairman, Vice- Chairman or a Member of a Local
Council from holding office to any Local Council for a period of five years
from the date of such order, if he is found guilty of corruption, misconduct or
abuse of powers as a result of inquiry under this section, besides any other
action as required under any law for the time being in force."
